e2db631e4240da0a.description:
Headquarters: Remote, Germany, EMEA

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re seeking a Principal Software Engineer to contribute to the technical architecture, design and development of Fivetran’s Managed Data Lake product offering. As part of a senior engineering team, you’ll partner with product and engineering teams to build scalable, high-performance systems, advance open-source technologies, and set technical standards that raise the bar across the organization.

This is a full-time remote position based out of Germany. 

Technologies You’ll Use

• Java, C++, Postgres, Temporal, gRPC

• AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Grafana

• Iceberg, Polaris, Delta Lake, Parquet, DuckDB

What You’ll Do

• Partner closely with product teams to understand requirements and design cutting-edge new capabilities that go directly into customer’s hands.

• Design, develop, implement, and operate highly reliable large-scale data lake systems in cooperation with a dedicated data lake engineering team.

• Contribute to open-source projects such as DuckDB and Polaris.

• Embrace Fivetran innovations with open-source standards and toolsets.

• Analyze fault-tolerance and high availability issues, performance and scale challenges, and solve them.

• Ensure operational excellence of the services and meet the commitments to our customers regarding security, reliability, availability, and performance.

• Set technical directions and influence cross-functional teams.

Skills We’re Looking For

• 6+ years of hands-on or research experience with high-performance relational data management systems.

• Deep understanding of infrastructure & software optimizations and performance engineering to drive significant performance, latency, and availability improvements.

• Proven track record of leading and delivering large and complicated projects.

• Strong development skills in Java and C++.

• Solid experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP).

• Demonstrated knowledge of columnar storage formats.

• Growth mindset and excitement about breaking the status quo by seeking innovative solutions.

• Excellent team player who is consistent in making everyone around you better.

Bonus Skills

• Strongly prefer an MS or PhD in Computer Science, ideally focusing on database management and/or storage engines.

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. With recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte's Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we're scaling rapidly and need a skilled Mobile Service Engineer to look after our growing estate across the North of England and Scotland.

Role Overview
We are seeking a hands-on and proactive Mobile Service Engineer to manage the maintenance and overall health of our car park infrastructure across the North of England and Scotland, ensuring that downtime on sites due to equipment failure is kept to a minimum. You'll be responsible for the ongoing maintenance of existing sites and the coordination of subcontractors to keep operations running seamlessly. The role calls for a mix of technical expertise, knowledge of CCTV/ANPR cameras and a problem-solving mindset, with regular site visits to either oversee or carry out maintenance work.

Location & Travel
This is a field-based role covering our northern estate, from Leeds up to Scotland. The ideal candidate will be based between Leeds and Dundee, and must be able to travel regularly to sites across all of our northern locations.

Key Responsibilities
• 
Equipment maintenance: Maintain ANPR cameras, Pay & Display machines, tablets, signage and other related equipment.
• 
RAMS: Ensure Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS) are prepared and followed when on site.
• 
Signage & frontline maintenance: Install and replace signage and kiosk consumables as required, ensuring compliance with safety and operational standards.
• 
Issue resolution: Diagnose and resolve technical issues on site, ensuring all equipment functions optimally.
• 
Compliance & safety: Adhere to all safe working procedures and compliance guidelines, ensuring a safe and effective work environment.
• 
Site visits: Visit sites across the North of England and Scotland on a scheduled basis to carry out general site health checks.
• 
Proactive monitoring: Plan and execute regular site visits and maintenance schedules across the northern estate to maintain a high-quality estate.
• 
Subcontractor coordination: Coordinate subcontractors on site to ensure maintenance and project work is delivered on time.

Skills & Qualifications
• 
Background in hands-on installation, ideally from companies or industries such as Sky, CCTV, BT, Field IT or IoT-related roles. (ANPR experience is beneficial but not required.)
• 
Experience working with subcontractors to ensure projects meet deadlines.
• 
Ability to work independently, making on-the-spot decisions to meet project objectives.
• 
Experience producing site documentation, such as site maps and install plans.
• 
Comfortable working alone, following installation plans and survey documents.
• 
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to multitask and adapt to dynamic site conditions.
• 
Based between Leeds and Dundee, and able to travel regularly across all of our sites in the North of England and Scotland.
• 
Full, clean UK driving licence (essential).
• 
Basic knowledge of Risk Assessments and RAMS documentation.

Desirable Qualifications / Certificates
• 
Asbestos Awareness
• 
Abrasive Wheels Certification
• 
Working at Height Certification
• 
Ladder Safety Training
• 
Health & Safety Awareness
• 
C&G 2365 (Electrical Installation)
• 
CAT & Genny Training
• 
IPAF (Powered Access Equipment)

What We Offer
• 
Competitive salary & benefits: Reflective of your experience and designed to support your professional growth and well-being.
• 
Company van for site travel.
• 
Company pension, sick pay and on-site parking.
• 
Flexible, home-based working: Split your time between home and our sites across the North of England and Scotland.

Why Hozah?
At Hozah, you'll play a pivotal role in a purpose-driven company at the forefront of urban mobility innovation. We foster a culture of collaboration, creativity and positive impact, where your contributions help shape the future of smarter cities. If you're looking to make a real difference in transforming the future of mobility, we'd love to hear from you. Join us and be part of this exciting journey!

Job Details
• 
Job type: Full-time
• 
Schedule: Monday to Friday
• 
Location: Field-based, North of England and Scotland (ideally based between Leeds and Dundee)

Hozah does not offer visa sponsorship for this role; applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

e2f1502c1e967f2b.description: Required Skills: Senior Paid Search Lead Location: [Remote] Type: [Full-Time] About Us: We are a performance-driven search marketing team that manages high-spend client accounts across Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, and regional search engines. We are judged on one thing: profitable, measurable business growth for our clients. Our work is built on first-party data, server-side measurement, value-based bidding, and incrementality testing, not on platform-reported vanity metrics. We give our senior people full ownership of client accounts and hold them accountable for real revenue, profit, and pipeline outcomes. Role Overview: We are looking for a Senior Paid Search Lead who can take a complete client account and grow it independently, with no strategist, analyst, or manager above them on that account. You will own everything from the initial audit and tracking architecture to bidding strategy, Performance Max control, feed optimization, experimentation, and direct reporting to the client’s CMO or founder. This role is built for someone who has already personally scaled accounts spending $100,000+ per month, can prove it with before-and-after numbers, and is as comfortable writing Google Ads Scripts and SQL queries as they are defending a growth plan in a boardroom. If your experience is mainly in social media buying, campaign execution under someone else’s strategy, or results you can only describe in CTR and impressions, this role is not a fit. 1. Bidding and Algorithm Control Value-based bidding architecture: designing conversion value schemes using margin, predicted LTV, or lead-stage values, and applying conversion value rules (by location, device, audience) to steer tROAS toward profit rather than revenue. Marginal vs. average ROAS thinking: using Performance Planner, bid strategy simulators, and spend-response curves to find where the next dollar stops being profitable, rather than optimizing to a blended ROAS target. Learning-phase management: knowing what resets learning, when to use seasonality adjustments for short predictable spikes (sales, launches), and when to apply data exclusions after tracking outages. Portfolio bid strategies with max/min CPC bid limits, shared budgets, and target impression share used deliberately for brand defense. New customer acquisition goals: configuring “bid higher for new customers” or “new customers only” modes using Customer Match lists and conversion-based customer detection. 2. Performance Max at Expert Level Cannibalization control: account-level brand exclusions, account-level negative keywords, and final URL expansion rules to stop PMax from harvesting brand and existing-customer demand. Asset group segmentation by margin tier, product category, or audience signal, with feed-only or retail-focused PMax setups where creative quality is weak. Channel performance and search term insights analysis to determine where spend actually goes (Search, Shopping, YouTube, Display, Discover, Gmail, Maps) and act on it. PMax vs. Standard Shopping vs. Search testing using campaign experiments and the ability to explain overlap and priority rules between them. 3. Search Campaign Craft N-gram analysis of search term reports at scale to find wasted spend patterns and new themes, rather than reviewing terms line by line. Match type strategy in the AI era: knowing when broad match plus Smart Bidding works, when it burns money, and how AI Max for Search changes query matching and final URLs. Negative keyword architecture: shared lists, cross-campaign sculpting, and protection against keyword conflicts. RSA asset strategy: pinning only where necessary, writing assets that each stand alone, and reading asset-level performance data correctly. 4. Measurement and Tracking Engineering Server-side Google Tag Manager deployment with a first-party subdomain, including understanding of data flow, cookie lifetime benefits, and cost implications. Enhanced Conversions (web and for leads) with correctly hashed first-party data, plus diagnosing match rate issues. Consent Mode v2 in advanced mode with a certified CMP, and understanding how conversion modeling fills consent gaps. Offline conversion imports using GCLID, GBRAID, and WBRAID, automated through CRM integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho) or the API, including conversion adjustments (restatements and retractions) for refunds and cancellations. GA4 to BigQuery export and the ability to reconcile platform-reported conversions against backend revenue. Conversion action hierarchy design: primary vs. secondary actions, conversion goals at account and campaign level, and counting settings. 5. Incrementality and Advanced Measurement Geo-based holdout experiments (matched markets, GeoLift or time-based regression methods) with power calculations and minimum detectable effect set before launch. Conversion lift studies on YouTube and Demand Gen, and knowing their limitations. Marketing mix modeling literacy: able to work with outputs from tools like Google Meridian or Robyn and translate them into budget decisions. Statistical rigor in testing: sample size, test duration, significance, and avoiding peeking and novelty effects. 6. Shopping and Feed Engineering Merchant Center Next and feed rules: supplemental feeds via Google Sheets or API, attribute rewriting, and fixing disapprovals and account-level suspensions (misrepresentation, policy). Custom label strategy driven by margin, stock levels, price competitiveness, and bestseller status, refreshed automatically. Title and product type optimization based on search query data, not guesswork. Price competitiveness and bestseller reports used to inform bidding and merchandising conversations with the client. Feed management platforms such as DataFeedWatch, Feedonomics, Channable, or Producthero. 7. Automation and Data Engineering Google Ads Scripts (JavaScript) written personally: budget pacing, anomaly alerts, n-gram reports, broken link checks, and automated negative keyword mining. Google Ads Query Language (GAQL) and working knowledge of the Google Ads API. SQL in BigQuery, using the Google Ads Data Transfer Service to build custom reporting tables. Looker Studio or similar BI tools for live client dashboards blending ad data with CRM and backend revenue. Python for analysis and automation is a strong plus. 8. Microsoft Advertising Beyond the Import Button Managing Microsoft-specific features: LinkedIn profile targeting for B2B, Microsoft Audience Network, Microsoft PMax, and Copilot-adjacent ad placements. Adjusting imported campaigns for Microsoft’s different auction dynamics, audience size, and bid levels instead of mirroring Google settings. Running separate UET tracking and Microsoft offline conversion imports. 9. Commercial and Financial Acumen Unit economics: contribution margin, POAS (profit on ad spend), LTV:CAC, payback period, and break-even ROAS calculations. Forecasting: building spend-to-revenue forecasts and growth scenarios the client’s finance team can sign off on. Budget negotiation: making a data-backed case for budget increases or reallocation to client leadership. Lead gen economics: cost per SQL, cost per opportunity, and pipeline-to-revenue modeling. 10. Audience and First-Party Data Strategy Customer Match segmentation by value tier, recency, and lifecycle stage, with regular automated refreshes. Exclusion strategy for existing customers, low-value segments, and converters. Audience signals for PMax and Demand Gen built from first-party data rather than generic in-market segments. 11. Account Diagnostics and Problem-Solving Root cause analysis of performance drops by separating tracking, auction, demand, competitive, site, and seasonality factors. Auction Insights trend analysis to detect competitor entry, aggressive bidding, or brand hijacking, and handling trademark complaints. Policy and suspension recovery: advertiser verification, circumvention or misrepresentation suspensions, and industry certifications (financial services, healthcare, gambling where applicable). Landing page diagnosis: identifying CRO issues hurting paid performance and briefing developers or designers on specific fixes. 12. Client Ownership Skills Running quarterly business reviews and strategy sessions directly with CMOs, founders, or marketing heads. Pushing back on clients with data when their requests would hurt performance. Writing clear growth plans with prioritized initiatives, expected impact, and timelines. Minimum Requirements (Non-Negotiable) 6+ years of hands-on paid search, with at least 3 years as the primary owner of accounts (not support, not “assisted with”). Personally managed a single account spending at least $100,000/month (₹80 lakh+), or a portfolio of $3M+ annually. A documented growth outcome you led, stated in numbers: for example, scaled revenue 2x+ at stable or improved ROAS, or cut CPA 30%+ while growing volume. Your resume must state the before and after figures, timeframe, and spend level. Full ownership of conversion tracking: you have personally implemented GTM (including server-side), GA4, Enhanced Conversions, Consent Mode v2, and offline conversion imports from a CRM. “Worked with the dev team” does not count. Value-based bidding in production: you have fed margin, LTV, or lead-quality values back into Smart Bidding and can show the impact. Performance Max at scale with control: brand exclusions, asset group segmentation by margin or product tier, feed-level custom labels, and search term/placement analysis. Microsoft Advertising experience beyond copying Google campaigns via import. SQL and scripting: you have written Google Ads Scripts or used the Google Ads API, and can query data in BigQuery or similar. Direct client-facing ownership: you have presented strategy and results to client decision-makers (Head of Marketing, CMO, founder) without a manager in the room. Strongly Preferred Incrementality testing experience (geo-holdouts, conversion lift studies) and a working understanding of MMM. Merchant Center feed optimization for catalogs of 5,000+ SKUs. Multi-market or multi-language account experience. Search Ads 360 experience. Experience rescuing an underperforming account and turning it around.

Headquarters: Remote, Australia

Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.

For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.

The customers you’ll work with are some of the most innovative businesses in the world, and the problems they’re trying to solve are real and urgent. You’ll bring a genuinely differentiated product to a market moving fast, at a company positioned to lead it. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.

The Role

We are looking to grow our rapidly expanding sales engineering team. As a Sales Engineer, you will help qualify and close opportunities with customers and partners and provide technical expertise through sales presentations, product demonstrations, and supporting technical evaluations. While location for this role is flexible, you must be based in the Central territory to be eligible for this role. You will:

• Work alongside the sales team to introduce CockroachDB to our potential customers. As a trusted advisor, you will help educate prospects on the unique capabilities of CockroachDB and design solutions to meet a wide variety of challenges.

• Lead product and solution briefings, build proof-of-concepts (POC), run live product demos, and prototype CockroachDB integrations.

• Partner with Cockroach Labs product management, engineering and support teams to solve customer challenges and improve CockroachDB.

• Identify and address customers' key technical objections and develop the engineering strategies strategy to resolve those blockers to adoption.

The Expectations

In your first 30 days, you will immerse yourself in CockroachDB and our sales motion. We believe that it's important for you to take this first month to become familiar with our company, technology and message.

During this time you will be an active listener on customer calls and build relationships with various teams at Cockroach Labs. As you gain confidence in the message and technology, you will be called upon to lead meetings with support from the team.

After 90 days, you should be ready to lead customer meetings without support and conduct POCs. You should be working closely with Account Managers in your territory to build regional go to market strategies and account plans for key prospects.

You Have

• 10-12+ years of prior experience collecting requirements, developing solution architectures, leading presentations and teaching prospective users or project teams how to use software similar to CockroachDB.

• Developed software or infrastructure for scalable, distributed systems in the past and want to stay close to the code.

• A passion for working on complex technical problems and have a strong understanding of modern infrastructure and database technologies.

• A strong ability to build relationships with our partners, customers, and open-source users.

• A collaborative spirit and enjoy making sure that each team gets customer feedback to keep improving CockroachDB.

• The flexibility to travel to meet customers, attend events or conferences or wherever the work takes you.

Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at accessibility@cockroachlabs.com.

Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.

Benefits

• Stock Options

• Medical Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Life and Disability Insurance

• Professional Development Funds

• Flexible Time Off

• Paid Holidays

• Paid Sick Days

• Paid Parental Leave

• Mental Wellbeing Benefits

• And more!

Salary is one component of the Cockroach Labs’ Total Rewards package, which also includes, for each employee: stock options, medical insurance, vision insurance, dental insurance, life and disability insurance, funds towards professional development resources, flexible paid time off, 11 paid holidays a year, 10 paid sick days a year, paid parental leave, a 401(k) plan, and wellbeing benefits.  

We set standard ranges for all U.S.-based roles based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. What We Do
Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.
Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.
We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are
Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.
The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.
Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.
Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need
We are building industry-defining accounting and finance software. We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Deployment Lead to join our team and help lead the successful onboarding of new customers onto Rillet.
This role is ideal for someone with a strong accounting foundation who is excited to work directly with customers and help finance teams modernize how they operate. You may come from Big 4 audit, accounting advisory, finance transformation, or an operational accounting role at a high-growth technology company. You do not need to have formally led ERP implementations before, but you do need to be systems-minded, highly organized, customer-oriented, and eager to learn quickly in a fast-paced startup environment.
We’re primarily looking for teammates who are based near our New York City or San Francisco offices, or open to relocating. For this role, we’re also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States. Our hybrid schedule brings office-based team members together in person on Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day each week. Some roles may spend more time in the office depending on the needs of the team.

What You'll Do

Lead key parts of customer onboarding and deployment, helping ensure a smooth and timely implementation experience
• 
Partner with internal teams across Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to execute implementation plans and solve customer problems quickly
• 
Learn and analyze client accounting and finance workflows, then translate those needs into clear requirements and practical solutions
• 
Guide customers through onboarding, training, change management, and adoption
• 
Support data migration, reconciliations, systems setup, and integration coordination
• 
Track milestones, drive follow-through, and keep internal and external stakeholders aligned throughout the onboarding process
• 
Identify risks early, escalate issues quickly, and help keep customer launches on track
• 
Build trust with customers by being responsive, thoughtful, and solutions-oriented
• 
Maintain clear documentation and provide regular status updates to customers and internal stakeholders

Who We're Looking For

4-7 years of experience in accounting, audit, advisory, or related customer-facing roles
• 
Strong accounting foundation, with the ability to speak credibly about close, reconciliations, revenue recognition (ASC 606), and core finance workflows
• 
Excellent communication skills and the presence to work directly with customers and senior stakeholders
• 
Systems-minded and excited to learn implementation work, even if you have not formally held an implementation title before
• 
Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams at once
• 
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high attention to detail
• 
Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams
• 
Experience in Big 4, SaaS or at a technology company is a plus

Life at Rillet

Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

This role is crucial for ensuring that our pricing strategies are competitive and profitable. Key Responsibilities: - Conduct detailed product costing analysis to determine the cost of goods sold and identify areas for cost reduction. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including production, finance, and sales, to gather data and insights for accurate costing. - Prepare and maintain cost models and reports to support pricing decisions and financial forecasting. - Monitor and analyze variances between actual and standard costs, providing insights and recommendations for improvement. - Assist in the development of pricing strategies based on cost analysis and market trends. - Ensure compliance with internal and external financial reporting standards related to product costing. Required Skills: - Strong analytical skills with a focus on product costing. - Proficiency in financial modeling and cost analysis. - Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with various teams. - Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
